api_url.description: The base URL for the TowerOps API. Defaults to https://towerops.net.

token.description: The API token for authenticating with TowerOps. This token determines which organization's resources are accessible.

block.description: The TowerOps provider allows you to manage TowerOps resources such as sites and devices.

id.description: The unique identifier of the agent.

inserted_at.description: The timestamp when the agent was created.

name.description: The name of the agent. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

token.description: The bearer token for this agent. Only available after creation and cannot be retrieved again.

block.description: Manages a TowerOps agent token. Agents are deployed on customer networks to poll devices via SNMP, ping, and SSH.

agent_token_id.description: The ID of the agent token that executes this check.

check_type.description: The type of check: http, tcp, dns, or ping.

content_match.description: Regex pattern to match against HTTP response body.

device_id.description: The ID of the device this check is associated with.

expect_string.description: Expected response string for TCP checks.

expected_status.description: Expected HTTP status code. Defaults to 200.

follow_redirects.description: Whether to follow HTTP redirects. Defaults to true.

host.description: The host to check. Used for TCP and ping checks.

hostname.description: The hostname to resolve. Required for DNS checks.

id.description: The unique identifier of the check.

inserted_at.description: The timestamp when the check was created.

interval_seconds.description: How often the check runs, in seconds.

last_check_at.description: Timestamp of the last check execution.

max_check_attempts.description: Number of consecutive failures before transitioning to hard state.

method.description: HTTP method to use. Defaults to GET.

ping_count.description: Number of ping packets to send. Defaults to 3.

port.description: The TCP port to check. Required for TCP checks.

record_type.description: DNS record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, PTR). Defaults to A.

retry_interval_seconds.description: Interval between retries after a failure, in seconds.

send_string.description: Data to send after TCP connection.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout for the check execution, in milliseconds.

url.description: The URL to check. Required for HTTP checks.

verify_ssl.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates. Defaults to true.

block.description: Manages a TowerOps service check. Supports HTTP, TCP, DNS, and ping check types.

device_role.description: The device type/role. Valid values: server, switch, router, access_point, backhaul, other. Defaults to 'other' if not specified.

id.description: The unique identifier of the device.

inserted_at.description: The timestamp when the device was created.

ip_address.description: The IP address of the device.

monitoring_enabled.description: Whether monitoring is enabled for this device.

name.description: The name of the device. If not provided, will be auto-discovered.

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization this device belongs to. Required if site_id is not provided.

site_id.description: The ID of the site this device belongs to. Optional if organization_id is provided.

snmp_enabled.description: Whether SNMP polling is enabled for this device.

snmp_version.description: The SNMP version to use (1, 2c, or 3).

snmpv3_auth_password.description: SNMPv3 authentication password. Only used when snmp_version is '3'.

snmpv3_auth_protocol.description: SNMPv3 authentication protocol (MD5, SHA, SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512). Only used when snmp_version is '3'.

snmpv3_priv_password.description: SNMPv3 privacy password. Only used when snmp_version is '3'.

snmpv3_priv_protocol.description: SNMPv3 privacy protocol (DES, AES, AES-192, AES-256). Only used when snmp_version is '3'.

snmpv3_security_level.description: SNMPv3 security level (noAuthNoPriv, authNoPriv, or authPriv). Only used when snmp_version is '3'.

snmpv3_username.description: SNMPv3 username. Only used when snmp_version is '3'.

block.description: Manages a TowerOps device. Devices represent network equipment at a site or directly in an organization.

description.description: A description of the escalation policy.

id.description: The unique identifier of the escalation policy.

inserted_at.description: The timestamp when the escalation policy was created.

name.description: The name of the escalation policy.

repeat_count.description: Number of times to repeat the escalation cycle. Defaults to 3.

enabled.description: Whether the integration is enabled. Defaults to true.

id.description: The unique identifier of the integration.

inserted_at.description: The timestamp when the integration was created.

provider_type.description: The integration provider type (e.g. pagerduty, slack, webhook).

sync_interval_minutes.description: How often the integration syncs, in minutes.

block.description: Manages a TowerOps integration with third-party services.

device_id.description: The device to apply the maintenance window to. If omitted, applies to all devices.

ends_at.description: The end time of the maintenance window in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-01-15T06:00:00Z).

id.description: The unique identifier of the maintenance window.

inserted_at.description: The timestamp when the maintenance window was created.

name.description: The name of the maintenance window.

reason.description: The reason for the maintenance window.

site_id.description: The site to apply the maintenance window to. If omitted, applies to all sites.

starts_at.description: The start time of the maintenance window in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-01-15T02:00:00Z).

suppress_alerts.description: Whether to suppress alerts during the maintenance window. Defaults to true.

block.description: Manages a TowerOps maintenance window. Maintenance windows suppress alerts during planned work periods.

id.description: The unique identifier of the organization.

name.description: The name of the organization. Can only be set by organization owners.

slug.description: The URL-friendly slug of the organization.

snmp_community.description: Default SNMP community string for devices. Can only be set by organization owners.

use_sites.description: Whether the organization uses sites to group devices. When true, devices are organized under sites. When false, devices belong directly to the organization.

block.description: Manages organization settings for the organization associated with the API token. There is exactly one organization per token, so this resource manages settings rather than creating or deleting organizations.

id.description: The unique identifier of the schedule.

inserted_at.description: The timestamp when the schedule was created.

name.description: The name of the on-call schedule.

timezone.description: The timezone for the schedule (e.g. America/Chicago).

address.description: The street address of the site.

id.description: The unique identifier of the site.

inserted_at.description: The timestamp when the site was created.

latitude.description: The latitude of the site (-90 to 90).

location.description: A short description of the physical location.

longitude.description: The longitude of the site (-180 to 180).

name.description: The name of the site. Must be between 2 and 200 characters.

snmp_community.description: The default SNMP community string for devices at this site.

block.description: Manages a TowerOps site. Sites represent physical locations that contain devices.
